free_tier.stated: A free program with no application fees, deadlines or cohorts. Members get developer tools and training, preferred pricing on NVIDIA hardware and software, and access to free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners. Membership requires a working website, official incorporation and an age under 10 years; solo founders with no other employees may apply.

chaining: Inception is the front door to the partner credit offers rather than a credit in itself, and the published partner credit found here, Lambda, is USD 1,000 and also demands incorporation. The chain is short and every link needs a company.

limits.value: The incorporation requirement fails first, so the member-only cloud credits and preferred hardware pricing are unreachable without a legal entity; the credit amount itself is not published.

identity_cost.detail: Explicitly requires the company to be 'officially incorporated', a working website, a business email on a non-generic domain (gmail.com and info@ aliases refused), and two named contacts, with a carve-out that solo founders may apply. The incorporation requirement is the binding term and is not waived for solo founders.

evidence.proved: qualification requires the company to be 'officially incorporated', less than 10 years old, with a working website and a non-generic business email, quoted
'Solo founders with no other employees may also apply' alongside the incorporation requirement, quoted
benefits include 'Access free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners', with no amount, tier or expiry published, quoted
the first-party program page states the free program, its member benefits, the absence of fees, deadlines or cohorts, and the incorporation and age requirements
evidence.quote: Inception is free. The program doesn’t have application fees, membership fees, or equity requirements. ... There are no application fees, deadlines, or cohorts. ... Inception members have access to the latest developer tools and training, preferred pricing on NVIDIA hardware and software ... Access free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners for more flexible, scalable development and deployment. ... Members must maintain a working website, be officially incorporated, be less than 10 years old, have a clear use case for NVIDIA technology, and be actively operated by at least one founder.

evidence.proved: the application page states that solo founders with no other employees may apply
evidence.quote: You need to provide unique contact information for two contacts who will manage your profile, technology details, and benefits. Solo founders with no other employees may also apply.

notes: Membership is free and the partner credits are the actual value, but no dollar figure is published for the NVIDIA-side cloud credits at all, so the amount is null rather than guessed. The application page adds that solo founders with no other employees may apply. The program that gates every partner credit requires a legal entity.
